environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label `pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: baseline` applied. Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy `disallow-host-path` with `validationFailureAction: Enforce` rejects any pod spec containing `hostPath` volume types. The namespace also carries annotation `pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce-version: v1.28` which under baseline profile blocks `privileged: true` in securityContext. Container runs as non-root (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534). However, no admission webhook validates the actual application logic or null-safety, and the recovery middleware still catches panics. The kubelet restart policy is `Always` with default exponential backoff (10s, 20s, 40s... capped at 5min).
